info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Peridot Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Peridot Syrup Catalog Management API enables users to add detailed information about Peridot Syrup products in the catalog. This API facilitates the submission of new syrup details, supporting the effective management of catalog inventory. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists working in food and beverage sectors. By ensuring accurate product representation, this API enhances visibility and aids in decision-making for suppliers and retailers.
